subject.title: fix: compaction usage guards and agent-loop turn correctness

question: Should `AgentOptions.prepareNextTurnWithContext` become the permanent additive public API, with documented precedence over the shipped `prepareNextTurn` hook?
rationale: The change repairs a real session-wrapper gap but creates a parallel plugin API contract whose naming, precedence, and long-term compatibility cannot be chosen safely from tests alone.

options.title: Approve additive hook
options.body: Keep both hooks, document context-hook precedence, and add focused compatibility tests for existing `prepareNextTurn` consumers.

options.title: Extend existing hook
options.body: Change the existing hook contract only with an explicit deprecation and migration plan for external consumers.

options.title: Keep context internal
options.body: Solve session refresh through an internal wrapper seam and avoid adding a public plugin API until a broader turn-hook design is agreed.

recommendation.title: Approve additive hook
recommendation.body: Keep both hooks, document context-hook precedence, and add focused compatibility tests for existing `prepareNextTurn` consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across compaction defaults and the agent-session boundary affected by this API choice.
